summary: Iteration 12: tested 3 features. (1) Note cover caption on /field-notes/what-the-haveli-reveals: when I started, the caption was EMPTY in the DB. The main agent's own note_caption_check.py had crashed partway through at 13:16 and left it empty. I re-added 'Views from the restoration in progress' in the live editor. Then the full caption check passed: caption shows publicly at 1440 and 390, it can be clicked and edited in the editor, saving works, emptying it hides it from visitors, the 'Add a caption' placeholder appears only while editing, and re-adding works. (2) Red lines: an audit script found every red ::before/::after line and red border on /, /about, /our-work/rakhigarhi, /our-work/theatre, /our-work/craft-livelihood, /our-work/workshops-learning, /connect, /field-notes and a note page, at 1920, 1280 and 390. All 0 bad: horizontal lines are 42x2px with a 30px gap (margin-top for lines below text, margin-bottom for lines above), and vertical lines (absolute ::after and craft's border-left) are 2px. (3) Live editor Edit Header > Style & spacing has the 'Red lines (whole site)' group with the 3 inputs. Setting 80/4/50 updated lines live (eyebrow, the hero line above text, vertical line 4px). Saving through PUT /api/admin/header-live returned 200, and the values showed in a fresh anonymous browser on rakhigarhi and workshops. Clearing the values and saving brought back 42/2/30 (header_styles is {} again). (4) Rakhigarhi #the-ambition: 2 columns at 1920, 1280 and 768. p1 and p2 are stacked on the left, p3 is on the right at the same top with a 1px rgb(221,214,207) border-left running the full height. At 390 it is a single column with a light border-top on p3 and no horizontal scroll. Backend pytest: 37/37 passed, including a new test file for site-styles validation (range limits, units, injection, clearing, auth).
action_items: Main agent's note_caption_check.py had a test bug: it scrolled to the empty figcaption while it was display:none, which timed out and left the client caption EMPTY in the DB. Fixed (it now scrolls only when the caption is visible), and the caption is restored.

note_caption_check.py's last check, 'no empty placeholder outside editor', fails because the test is wrong, not the app: the live editor stays open across navigation (sessionStorage usp-live-edit), so body.live-editing is still set. A logged-in admin who has not opened the editor correctly sees display:none.
critical_code_review_comments: accent-lines.css lists `.page-home [data-testid="block-0"] .lede` and `.page-home #our-work .sec-head .h2`, but these match nothing (the home page has no red lines). Same for `.theatre-split-intro` and `.theatre-intro-heading`, which are not in the current content. These rules are dead but harmless; remove them or confirm the home page should have red lines.

Vertical lines in absolute ::after (about, rakhigarhi aside, workshops prose) pick up --accent-line through width, so the thickness setting works for them. Craft uses border-left-width. Both are covered.
seed_data_creation: None. Note caption restored to 'Views from the restoration in progress'; header_styles back to {}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real page paths are /our-work/theatre, /our-work/craft-livelihood and /our-work/workshops-learning (/theatre etc. give 404). Run playwright tests with /usr/local/bin/python3. Run backup_restore_content.py and pytest with python3 (venv). My /tmp/content_backup.json was taken while the caption was empty, so do NOT restore from it blindly: a diff on the notes doc 6ad71ee... is expected and is only the caption. Accent lines: red_lines_audit.py <width> [w h gap] checks every red line. accent_lines_editor_check.py sets 80/4/50, saves, checks public pages, then resets.
rca of the issue: The empty caption at the start was caused by the test, not the app. note_caption_check.py set the caption to '' and saved. In public_caption() it then called scroll_into_view_if_needed() on the figcaption with class photo-caption-empty, which is display:none for visitors. That timed out after 30s and the script stopped before the re-add step, so the client caption stayed empty. Fix: scroll only when the caption is visible (applied).
